#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
for f in "$HOME"/notes/*.md; do
  echo "file: $f" | grep -c note || true
done
export PATH="/usr/local/bin:$PATH"
Markie

name: Markie
version: 1.2
features:
  - notes
  - sync # comment
enabled: true
SELECT id, title FROM notes WHERE pinned = TRUE AND views > 10 ORDER BY title;
